items.title: WS4 — PPG proof-out in the foam earcup at the mastoid
items.note: HR app reconnect bug fixed (7fb6614). 8 recordings with the MAX86171 in the pillow, headset worn (30 Oct, 3 Nov). 3 Nov: BPM present in 84% of rows still (median 101), 27% moving (median 97), 81% left tilt (median 49.5, suspect), 90% right tilt (median 94). No reference device yet, so accuracy is unproven. Next: record still + movement beside a reference.

items.title: WS1 — H1 Rev-C master assembly: final, fully dressed virtual headset
items.note: WS2812 16-LED ring mounts on both earcups: slim snap clips, glue sockets and cable passages (5 Nov); parts printing, fit not checked yet. CAD viewer updated to assembly v243. Traced 066 earcup source and found the V5 flat band; band measured for CX Steel strip samples. Open: flex-tail clearance, full parametric 066 rebuild.

items.title: WS2 — H1 manufacturing plan and full BOM
items.note: Clear-cover mould: redesigned, reprinted and assembled (2 Nov); Mold Star 15 silicone halves poured 3 and 4 Nov with sprue and vents; demoulded 5 Nov, keys fit. First KRISTAL 50 resin cover injected 5 Nov, curing. Backup printed cover sanded 120-1200 grit. Strap: TPU insert at Sewing Hub, CX Steel samples (quote pending). Open: demould + clarity, costed BOM.
